title: The Day Kevin Gibbon Closed Shyp and Named His Own Mistakes
conflicts: Launch year 2014 (Gibbon, The Verge) vs 2013 (TechCrunch 2017, probably the company's formation); story uses 2014. 2015 valuation $250 million, with TechCrunch sources ranging up to $275 million; story says 'reported at $250 million'. Total raised $62 million (Transport Topics via CB Insights) matches TechCrunch's $12.1 million plus the $50 million round. No source quantifies the 2017 or 2018 layoffs, so none is given. The 'two years earlier' pivot timing and December 2017 break-even are attributed to Gibbon.
notes: Gibbon's closing post is on LinkedIn and loads for the checker. Quote is Meditations VIII.16 (stance affirms), set against Gibbon's own admission that he admired founders who ignored advice.
